last.summary: The CRC spec meets the task: it defines the MSB-first bitwise CRC, original-byte block CRC, and rotate/XOR stream CRC, imports the module, and checks the requested examples. I verified the polynomial, initialization and complement, byte update, block input coverage, and combination against the vendored C source; an out-of-tree build reproduced both CRCs and the trailer for the two-block example. The full bzip2 verify.sh passed. The diff stays within the allowed spec files, with no Lean holes or oracle API changes.
